_source: The commissioner's published sheet, as supplied by the pool owner. Every value here has been read off the official sheet — nothing is inferred. This file is the regression baseline: if rules.yaml ever drifts from it, tests/test_official_rules.py fails and names the team and both numbers.
_not_covered: The sheet is silent on tied games. NFL games can end level (2025 had one), so the pool's tie policy lives in rules.yaml as `tie_multiplier` and is a commissioner decision rather than something derived.
